question: Does joint 6-DOF Levenberg-Marquardt descent on surrogate-MSE recover truth from ICs inside the s003 truth-ω tube, and how large is the per-seed basin of attraction?
hypothesis: Joint (q0, ω) LM from inside the s003 tube converges to truth basin reliably; basin radius is seed-dependent.
narrative_md: Joint 6-DOF LM on surrogate-MSE recovers truth from inside the s003 tube on 4/5 seeds and 18/20 random in-tube ICs (90%). Convergence is bimodal (success: q0_err<1°, ω_dir_err<0.05°; failure: 20-180°). Per-seed basin radius is seed-dependent (2°-15° q0, ~1-2° ω-dir, ~3-5% ω-mag) with seed 28 the tight outlier (~2°). Twin recoveries 0/50. Seed 91 (the m115 anchor) converges from inside the tube — its m115 failure was an outer-ω-search problem, not local descent. Joint LM is the viable inversion architecture.
